name: gizza-ai/email-validate
summary: Validate email syntax and check MX deliverability over DNS-over-HTTPS

tool.description: Validate one email address, then use DNS-over-HTTPS to check whether its domain publishes MX records (or an RFC 5321 implicit A/AAAA fallback). Reports MX priority, TTL, optional host IPs, risk, and an explicit no-SMTP caveat.

email.description: Email address to validate before looking up its domain's MX records.

resolver.description: DNS-over-HTTPS resolver to query for MX records.

fallback_a.description: When a domain has no MX, also query A/AAAA records and apply RFC 5321's implicit-MX fallback.

resolve_ips.description: Also resolve A/AAAA addresses for each reported MX host (one extra lookup per host).

max_records.description: Maximum MX records to list after sorting by preference (1-50, default 10).

format.description: Output format: human report, one-line summary, or machine-readable JSON.
